text: This application proposes to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law to permit two new 50- and 46-storey towers, on a shared four-storey base building. The proposed development will consist of 1032 residential dwelling units, commercial uses, and a 400-person worship/performance hall and a full-sized gymnasium. The existing church building on the site would be relocated to the southeast corner and repurposed to contain retail and commercial uses. The proposed tower heights would be 162 metres plus two storeys of mechanical penthouse and 150 metres plus a one-storey of mechanical penthouse. A Floor Space Index of 15 times the area of the lot is proposed. This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Official Plan and Zoning By-law subject to conditions listed in the holding provisions.
